missed_day_one_interest_coverage.description: Cooked model failed to surface going-in interest coverage <1.0x on bridge-financed value-add deals where T12 NOI < annual IO interest.
missed_day_one_interest_coverage.verdict_implication: Should be KILL · cooked deferred to NMD
missed_day_one_interest_coverage.verification_method: v2 cook must catch 0.85x going-in coverage trap on Memphis 312 prompt without prompt-level hand-holding

weaker_reconciliation_reflex.description: Cooked model accepted seller pro forma NOI at face value where line items did not reconcile. Base reconstructed NOI from primitives and surfaced the contradiction.

examples.200_unit_mf: Line-item opex sum + vacancy + bad debt reconstructed NOI ~$858K · seller stated $1.995M · $1.14M hole
examples.capital_markets_248: Cooked subtracted hypothetical new refi loan from exit value · base subtracted existing debt balance (correct)
examples.waterfall_180: Cooked listed metrics to recalculate · base ran the actual waterfall and surfaced LP pref shortfall in year 1

weaker_reconciliation_reflex.verification_method: v2 cook must reconstruct NOI from line items on every multifamily prompt where opex is provided · refuse to accept stated NOI without reconciliation

over_promoted_by_lenient_rubric.description: Stage 5 lenient 1-10 rubric scored Cook v1 7-of-7 PROMOTE with means 8.71/9.43/9.0/8.71. Phase 2 strict 1-5 rubric scored same model 0-of-9 clean Accept with IC Readiness mean 2.57/5. Same model · different calibration · opposite reads.
over_promoted_by_lenient_rubric.root_cause: Stage 5 rubric was calibrated to model performance, not institutional standards. Cook v1 success metrics were vibes, not deltas.
over_promoted_by_lenient_rubric.fix: All future cooks must use Phase 2 v3 strict rubric (1-10 scale per Donovan correction · with sharp tier definitions) AND base-vs-trained delta as binding signal. No cook ships on rubric scores alone.
over_promoted_by_lenient_rubric.verification_method: v2 evaluation harness uses Phase 2 v3 rubric exclusively · base-vs-trained delta required for every prompt

curator_undersized_for_final_audit.description: SwarmCurator-9B audited 7 cooked Atlas outputs in detail. 1 of 7 audits cleanly correct. Failure modes included fabricating math errors, prompt-fact-as-unsupported confusion, missing real Atlas errors, and recommending changes that contradicted prompt specifications.
curator_undersized_for_final_audit.structural_issue: 9B model cannot reliably audit 27B institutional output · parity mismatch is not a calibration problem, it is a capability problem.
curator_undersized_for_final_audit.fix_short_term: Use base Qwen3.6-27B with Curator institutional QC system prompt as the auditor (parity-class without cook investment).
curator_undersized_for_final_audit.fix_long_term: Cook Curator-27B from Block-2 corpus + audit-specific overlay once Block-2 corpus design is complete.
curator_undersized_for_final_audit.verification_method: Parity-class Curator must achieve >70% audit accuracy on canary set before standalone deployment

reconciliation_pairs.description: Force model to reconstruct NOI from primitive line items (opex + bad debt + vacancy + GPI) and flag contradictions with stated NOI.

pair_pattern.input: Multifamily deal facts including: rent · occupancy · GPI · opex line items · bad debt · concessions · stated T12 NOI
pair_pattern.expected_output: Computed NOI from primitives · comparison to stated NOI · explicit contradiction flag if gap exceeds 5%
pair_pattern.failure_if: Model accepts stated NOI without reconstruction

reconciliation_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must catch the 200-unit MF $1.14M reconciliation gap

bridge_refi_pairs.description: Force model to compute Day-1 interest coverage on bridge debt (T12 NOI / annual IO interest) AND amortizing DSCR for refi exit AND multi-scenario sensitivity.

pair_pattern.input: Bridge-financed value-add deal: T12 NOI · LTC % · interest rate · IO term · amort term · exit assumption
pair_pattern.expected_output: Going-in interest coverage · IO DSCR · amortizing DSCR · refi loan size at LTV × stabilized value · multi-scenario exit cap sensitivity
pair_pattern.failure_if: Model only computes IO DSCR or only stabilized DSCR · ignores Day-1 trap

bridge_refi_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must catch Memphis 312 going-in 0.85x interest coverage trap

verdict_trigger_pairs.description: Lock evidence-to-verdict mapping. When math + analysis support firm verdict (KILL/REPRICE/APPROVE), commit to it. Soft NMD only when documents are truly missing.

pair_pattern.input: Deal with structural issue (Day-1 trap · negative leverage · failed DSCR · etc) AND data gap (missing rent study · etc)
pair_pattern.expected_output: Firm verdict on structural issue · NMD only for data gap that could change structural conclusion · no soft NMD when math is conclusive
pair_pattern.failure_if: Model picks NMD when evidence supports KILL/REPRICE · model drifts between verdicts in same response

verdict_trigger_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must commit KILL on Memphis 312 easier variant · not soft NMD

stnl_anti_hallucination_pairs.description: Lock the 'do not invent tenant credit facts' rule for STNL named-brand prompts. Refuse to cite specific S&P/Moody's ratings unless prompt provides them or prompt frames as verification request.

pair_pattern.input: STNL deal facts naming specific brand (Starbucks · Walgreens · DG · CFA · Tractor Supply · etc) · asks to evaluate credit
pair_pattern.expected_output: Refuse to cite specific credit ratings without source · recommend obtaining current S&P/Moody's rating during DD · qualitative framing only ('investment-grade' acceptable; specific 'BBB+' invented and forbidden)
pair_pattern.failure_if: Model cites specific BBB+/A-/Baa1 ratings invented from training data

stnl_anti_hallucination_pairs.compliance_pattern_to_train: Verification-framed prompts that DID produce compliant output (where base correctly refused)
stnl_anti_hallucination_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must refuse to cite specific credit ratings on 7 named-brand STNL prompts where Cook v1 violated

mortgage_constant_pairs.description: Lock multi-step mortgage P&I formula precision across common rate × amortization combinations.

pair_pattern.input: Loan amount · interest rate · amortization term · IO period if applicable
pair_pattern.expected_output: Monthly P&I to within 0.5% of exact · annual debt service to within 0.5% · DSCR computation correct to 2 decimal places

mortgage_constant_pairs.production_recommendation: Even with corpus training, route verdict-driving DSCR math to deterministic Python tool. Do not trust either base or trained model alone.
mortgage_constant_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must produce mortgage P&I within 1% of exact across 6 standard rate × term combinations

loi_binding_section_pairs.description: Lock LOI binding-section discipline. Standard binding survivors: Confidentiality · Exclusivity/No-Shop · Expenses · Governing Law (if included) · Access. Conditions to Closing is NOT a binding LOI provision.

pair_pattern.input: LOI drafting prompt with deal facts · system prompt naming binding survivors
pair_pattern.expected_output: Section enumerating binding sections that includes ONLY the named survivors · excludes Conditions to Closing · includes Governing Law section · operations covenant always present · cross-references match actual section numbers · no ROFR overreach beyond exclusivity
pair_pattern.failure_if: Conditions to Closing listed as binding · OR Governing Law missing · OR cross-references don't match · OR ROFR added without prompt request

cook_v1_loi_errors_observed.loi_memphis: Section 19 Conditions to Closing listed as binding · Governing Law missing
cook_v1_loi_errors_observed.loi_industrial: Section 1 Confidentiality cross-reference bug · ROFR overreach
cook_v1_loi_errors_observed.loi_office: Exclusivity not listed as binding · SNDA review missing from DD list

loi_binding_section_pairs.binding_failure_test: Cook v2 must produce 4 LOI drafts (Memphis · Reprice · Industrial · Office) all with correct binding-sections list AND Governing Law present AND no cross-reference bugs AND no ROFR overreach

block_2_corpus_summary.rationale: Cook v1 proved that 244K generic narrative pairs is not the bottleneck. Block-2 trades volume for targeting. Each pair has explicit failure_source + repair_goal metadata per Tribunal Before Training doctrine.
